steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Th-they've all been knocked out? I... never knew you were so powerful.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I've thought about it before, but...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: That's why I didn't want you to know.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But that was amazing! You're really cool, Schwarz!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: How'd you jump that high?! You ran up the wall and did a somersault!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Then you spun around in midair and dodged all their shots!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Then you turned around, and bang bang! You took them all out just like that! My goodness!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady... You're making me blush.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But Schwarz, there is one thing I have to correct. I wasn't giving you an order. That was just a request from a friend.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If you ever need anything from me, just tell me.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hmm? What did I just say?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: There's no need to talk like that! We're friends, friends!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Um... sure then.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Haha! Let's head to the City Hall now. I wonder how Rhodes Island is doing...

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: These imbeciles... They can't even stop a little girl?!

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: But she's a Sarkazian! Plus, there are several others with her!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: It's only a handful of them!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: D-damn it! What is Rhodes Island doing here?!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Huh... Feels like these guys are even weaker than Originium slugs...

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Call everyone over here right now!

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: But, Mister Cronin...

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: I don't think numbers are going to help!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: No such thing! Don't you dare take a step back!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: *yawn*... Hey Doctor, did you find it yet? I still want to go see that concert. We're going to miss it if we take too long here.

options: Mhm. I've already found the logbooks and bonds.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Huh? You found it? See, beating some sense into them works after all. Meteorite was right. Sometimes, violence solves everything!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: D-Damn it all!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Whatever. As long as I can get out of here, it's easy enough to forge a registration.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Ah, Doctor, he jumped out from the window!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Okay~

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hmm, the General is still out there, right? I feel like this Cronin is going to have a tragic end... It would've been better for him to stay inside.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: C'mon, Doctor, I'll help you out!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: *gasp* *gasp*... Damn it...

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: I've got... to call the others back right now!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Last time, it was Miss Ceylon and the Doctor of Rhodes Island jumping out from that window.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: This time, it's you. Karma is poetic, isn't it, Mister Cronin?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: These things happen in life, sir.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: You... You! What'd you do to them? What'd you do to them?!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: They'd be an eyesore to the beautiful view here.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: By the way, you've kept these young ladies waiting for quite some time.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Schwarz...

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: You two are standing together, which means...

options: You can't escape the law. We have all the evidence.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Doctor, please be careful. He may make one last desperate attempt.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Damn you... All of you...!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Your plot has been exposed, Cronin!
